title: RAP message text silently cut after 50 characters
symptom: A long text passed to new_message_with_text( text = … ) arrives in Fiori cut at 50 characters (Vietnamese diacritics count as 1).
rootCause: CL_ABAP_BEHV->NEW_MESSAGE_WITH_TEXT puts the whole text into v1 of message SABP_BEHV 100; msgv1 is TYPE symsgv (CHAR 50). Cut in the backend, before OData.

solutions.label: Long text in an abap.string field of the entity
solutions.body: Result/message column with @UI.lineItem; keep %msg short and pointing at it.

solutions.label: Own message class
solutions.body: INHERITING FROM cx_static_check, INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message, redefine if_message~get_text returning a string. One new object (TR if transportable).

solutions.label: T100 with &1&2&3&4
solutions.body: 4 x 50 chars, split on word boundaries. Weakest option.

prevention: Never route API/BAPI error texts through new_message_with_text.
evidence: memory rap-message-text-50-char-limit (SAP source CL_ABAP_BEHV read on the DEV tenant 2026-08-24)
